sourceTitle: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
originalTitle: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more

blocks.text: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.
blocks.zh: CodeRabbit使用OpenAI模型来管理和信任AI生成的代码和Codex,将20倍多的软件运送给同一个工程团队.
blocks.en: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to govern and trust AI-generated code and Codex to ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team.

blocks.text: Company size: Startup
blocks.zh: 公司规模 :启动
blocks.en: Company size: Startup

blocks.text: Region: North America
blocks.zh: 区域 :北美
blocks.en: Region: North America

blocks.text: Industry: Technology
blocks.zh: 工业:技术
blocks.en: Industry: Technology

blocks.text: Products: API, Codex, Daybreak
blocks.zh: 产品:API, (英语).代码日间休息
blocks.en: Products: API, Codex, Daybreak

blocks.text: For Harjot Gill, co-founder and CEO of CodeRabbit ⁠, trusting and validating agentic code is becoming the place where teams bring judgment to a growing volume of AI-generated work. “The first bottleneck that every company hits as soon as you adopt coding agents is code reviews,” Harjot says.
blocks.zh: 为了哈霍特·吉尔CodeRabbit的创始人兼首席执行官信任和验证代理代码正在成为团队对越来越多的AI生成的作品做出判断的地方.Harjot说,“每个公司一采用编码代理就遇到的第一个瓶颈是代码审查。”
blocks.en: For Harjot Gill, co-founder and CEO of CodeRabbit ⁠, trusting and validating agentic code is becoming the place where teams bring judgment to a growing volume of AI-generated work. “The first bottleneck that every company hits as soon as you adopt coding agents is code reviews,” Harjot says.

blocks.text: CodeRabbit built an AI-powered governance and control platform designed to validate and trust AI-generated code. Used by over 20,000 organizations and 150,000+ open-source projects, CodeRabbit helps teams understand, review, and secure code produced by AI agents and decide what is ready to ship.
blocks.zh: CodeRabbit建立了一个AI动力治理和控制平台,旨在验证和信任AI生成的代码.2万多个组织和150,000+开源项目使用,代码Rabbit帮助团队理解,审查,以及AI智能体制作的安全密码 并决定准备运送什么
blocks.en: CodeRabbit built an AI-powered governance and control platform designed to validate and trust AI-generated code. Used by over 20,000 organizations and 150,000+ open-source projects, CodeRabbit helps teams understand, review, and secure code produced by AI agents and decide what is ready to ship.

blocks.text: According to CodeRabbit, better price-performance from OpenAI helps it add more AI agents to its reviews and pass the benefits to customers, and Codex ⁠ helps it ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team. The company also uses Daybreak ⁠ to both secure its own stack and its customers’ code. Its latest offering, CodeRabbit Secure, uses Daybreak with Codex models to find and fix vulnerabilities using its security-focused agents.
blocks.zh: 根据代码Rabbit,OpenAI的更好价格业绩有助于它在其审查中增加更多的AI代理商,并将好处传递给客户,和Codex QQ帮助它与同一个工程团队一起运送20倍多的软件.公司还使用Daybreak QQ来保护自己的堆栈和客户的代码.其最新提议,代码Rabbit安全,使用Daybreak与 Codex 模型,使用其以安全为重点的代理来发现和解决薄弱环节.
blocks.en: According to CodeRabbit, better price-performance from OpenAI helps it add more AI agents to its reviews and pass the benefits to customers, and Codex ⁠ helps it ship 20 times more software with the same engineering team. The company also uses Daybreak ⁠ to both secure its own stack and its customers’ code. Its latest offering, CodeRabbit Secure, uses Daybreak with Codex models to find and fix vulnerabilities using its security-focused agents.

blocks.text: “With each OpenAI model release, especially with the reasoning models, we have seen massive improvements in the capabilities of our product to find issues at scale.”
blocks.zh: “随着OpenAI模型的发布,特别是推理模型,我们看到,我们产品发现规模问题的能力大有提高。”
blocks.en: “With each OpenAI model release, especially with the reasoning models, we have seen massive improvements in the capabilities of our product to find issues at scale.”

blocks.text: – Harjot Gill, co-founder and CEO, CodeRabbit
blocks.zh: - 哈乔特・吉尔,联合创始人兼首席执行官,代码拉比
blocks.en: – Harjot Gill, co-founder and CEO, CodeRabbit

blocks.text: Improving code review with OpenAI reasoning models
blocks.zh: 使用 OpenAI 推理模型改进代码审查
blocks.en: Improving code review with OpenAI reasoning models

blocks.text: CodeRabbit built its first product with GPT‑3.5 Turbo. Harjot says the arrival of GPT‑4 made the product effective at reviewing code. The company went on to adopt OpenAI o1 and OpenAI o3 early. Because code reviews run asynchronously in the cloud, CodeRabbit could use models that took longer to reason through a problem in exchange for more capable analysis.
blocks.zh: CodeRabbit用GPT ⁇ 3.5涡轮制造了它的第一种产品.Harjot说,GPT ⁇ 4的到来使得产品在审查代码时有效.公司继续提前采用OpenAI o1和OpenAI o3.因为代码评论在云中同步运行,CodeRabbit可以使用花费更长时间通过问题推理的模型,以换取更有能力的分析.
blocks.en: CodeRabbit built its first product with GPT‑3.5 Turbo. Harjot says the arrival of GPT‑4 made the product effective at reviewing code. The company went on to adopt OpenAI o1 and OpenAI o3 early. Because code reviews run asynchronously in the cloud, CodeRabbit could use models that took longer to reason through a problem in exchange for more capable analysis.

blocks.text: The team evaluates new models against its own benchmark of known issues. At the time of the interview, Harjot estimated that GPT‑6 Astra ⁠ caught 50% of the issues in that dataset, putting it at the top compared to other models in that benchmark.
blocks.zh: 该小组根据自己的已知问题基准评价新模式。在接受采访时,Harjot估计GPT ⁇ 6 Astra 抓住了该数据集50%的问题,与该基准中的其他模型相比,将其置于顶端。
blocks.en: The team evaluates new models against its own benchmark of known issues. At the time of the interview, Harjot estimated that GPT‑6 Astra ⁠ caught 50% of the issues in that dataset, putting it at the top compared to other models in that benchmark.

blocks.text: The benchmark continues to evolve as agents introduce different kinds of mistakes and as fixes reveal problems earlier reviews missed. “The nature of bugs keeps evolving, so does our benchmark as the models get better,” says Harjot.
blocks.zh: 基准继续演变,因为代理商提出了不同类型的错误,而且纠正办法揭示了以前没有审查的问题。“虫子的性质不断演变,哈霍特说,我们的基准也随着模型的改进而提高。
blocks.en: The benchmark continues to evolve as agents introduce different kinds of mistakes and as fixes reveal problems earlier reviews missed. “The nature of bugs keeps evolving, so does our benchmark as the models get better,” says Harjot.

blocks.text: Better price-performance from OpenAI models has helped CodeRabbit move capabilities from research into its product. Harjot points to improvements in model pricing and caching that let the company use more AI, add more subagents, and pass the benefits to customers.
blocks.zh: 来自OpenAI模型的更好价格性能帮助了CodeRabbit将研究能力转移到其产品中.Harjot指出模型定价和缓冲的改进让公司使用更多的AI,添加更多副剂,将利益传递给客户。
blocks.en: Better price-performance from OpenAI models has helped CodeRabbit move capabilities from research into its product. Harjot points to improvements in model pricing and caching that let the company use more AI, add more subagents, and pass the benefits to customers.

blocks.text: When CodeRabbit started, it used one or two subagents for code navigation. Lower-cost models such as GPT‑6 Luna now support more subagents throughout the platform, while models such as GPT‑6 Astra handle planning and orchestration.
blocks.zh: 当 CodeRabbit 开始时,它用一两个副剂进行密码导航成本较低的模型,如GPT ⁇ 6 Luna 现在支持更多的子剂 整个平台,而在GPT ⁇ 6等模型中,Astra处理规划和指挥.
blocks.en: When CodeRabbit started, it used one or two subagents for code navigation. Lower-cost models such as GPT‑6 Luna now support more subagents throughout the platform, while models such as GPT‑6 Astra handle planning and orchestration.

blocks.text: “Now we are using agents everywhere on the use cases we couldn't even afford in the past,” Harjot says. That expands the validation CodeRabbit can perform and the explanations it can give developers, helping them understand and trust changes they did not write themselves.
blocks.zh: Harjot说:“现在,我们到处都在使用我们过去连买不起的使用案件。”扩展验证 CodeRabbit 可以执行 和它能给开发者的解释,帮助他们理解和信任他们没有写自己的变化。
blocks.en: “Now we are using agents everywhere on the use cases we couldn't even afford in the past,” Harjot says. That expands the validation CodeRabbit can perform and the explanations it can give developers, helping them understand and trust changes they did not write themselves.

blocks.text: By using Codex, Harjot says the company has been shipping roughly 20 times more software over the last 6 months without adding engineers. He personally estimates that he pushed 2,500 to 3,000 pull requests in the 30 days before the interview.
blocks.zh: 通过使用Codex,Harjot说,在过去的六个月里,该公司运输的软件大约是20倍,没有增加工程师。他个人估计,在面谈前的30天内,他提出了2,500至3,000项拉动请求。
blocks.en: By using Codex, Harjot says the company has been shipping roughly 20 times more software over the last 6 months without adding engineers. He personally estimates that he pushed 2,500 to 3,000 pull requests in the 30 days before the interview.

blocks.text: Getting there required more than adopting Codex. Running multiple agents exposed constraints across the development process, from laptop memory and compute to testing, the tools that compile and package software, and dependencies.
blocks.zh: 到达那里需要的不仅仅是通过Codex.在整个发展进程中,经营多个代理商暴露出各种制约因素,从笔记本电脑内存和计算到测试,汇编和包装软件的工具,和依赖关系。
blocks.en: Getting there required more than adopting Codex. Running multiple agents exposed constraints across the development process, from laptop memory and compute to testing, the tools that compile and package software, and dependencies.

blocks.text: The team streamlined its release process and reconsidered where human approvals belonged, while using CodeRabbit to automatically ship low-risk changes that didn’t need human intervention. “We had to actually completely rethink the entire software delivery,” Harjot says.
blocks.zh: 该小组简化了发布程序,并重新考虑了属于人类批准的范围,使用 CodeRabbit 自动传送不需要人干预的低风险变化。Harjot说:“我们实际上必须彻底重新思考整个软件的交付,”
blocks.en: The team streamlined its release process and reconsidered where human approvals belonged, while using CodeRabbit to automatically ship low-risk changes that didn’t need human intervention. “We had to actually completely rethink the entire software delivery,” Harjot says.

blocks.text: The company has also built a Codex-powered Slack bot that triages production incidents, Slack messages, and support tickets. It can return a pull request for the team to review and merge. Harjot sees cloud-based development as a way to reduce local-machine constraints and give teams stronger controls over access and auditing.
blocks.zh: 公司还建造了一台由Codex驱动的Slack机器人 用于分解生产事件,黑话,还要买票它可以返回一个拉动请求,要求团队审查和合并.Harjot认为基于云的发展是减少当地机器限制的一种方式,并赋予团队对访问和审计的更强大的控制.
blocks.en: The company has also built a Codex-powered Slack bot that triages production incidents, Slack messages, and support tickets. It can return a pull request for the team to review and merge. Harjot sees cloud-based development as a way to reduce local-machine constraints and give teams stronger controls over access and auditing.

blocks.text: CodeRabbit uses Codex for work beyond engineering, including managing marketing and operational tasks through code. “We are running the company as code as much as possible,” Harjot says.
blocks.zh: CodeRabbit在工程之外的工作中使用Codex,包括通过代码管理营销和业务任务。Harjot说:“我们正在尽可能多地管理这个公司。”
blocks.en: CodeRabbit uses Codex for work beyond engineering, including managing marketing and operational tasks through code. “We are running the company as code as much as possible,” Harjot says.

blocks.text: In marketing, the company manages Google Ads through pull requests. The team opens and merges a request to deploy ads. It also uses a content studio repository where Codex creates slide decks and customer-facing documents. “If you can translate your marketing problems to code problems, you will run 10x faster,” Harjot says.
blocks.zh: 在市场营销方面,该公司通过拉动请求管理Google Ads.团队打开并合并了部署广告的请求.它还使用一个内容工作室寄存器,其中Codex创建了幻灯片甲板和客户界面文档.“如果你能将你的营销问题转化为代码问题,Harjot说,
blocks.en: In marketing, the company manages Google Ads through pull requests. The team opens and merges a request to deploy ads. It also uses a content studio repository where Codex creates slide decks and customer-facing documents. “If you can translate your marketing problems to code problems, you will run 10x faster,” Harjot says.

blocks.text: Securing application code with Daybreak
blocks.zh: 使用 Daybreak 来保证应用程序代码
blocks.en: Securing application code with Daybreak

blocks.text: CodeRabbit has run agents in sandbox environments since 2023, cloning repositories and letting agents write code to help perform reviews. More recently, CodeRabbit used OpenAI’s Cyber model through Daybreak to test and secure its own platform.
blocks.zh: CodeRabbit从2023年起在沙盒环境中运行代理,克隆寄存器 和让代理人写代码 帮助执行审查。更近一点,CodeRabbit通过Daybreak使用OpenAI的网络模型来测试和保障自己的平台.
blocks.en: CodeRabbit has run agents in sandbox environments since 2023, cloning repositories and letting agents write code to help perform reviews. More recently, CodeRabbit used OpenAI’s Cyber model through Daybreak to test and secure its own platform.

blocks.text: The team used the model for internal penetration testing, probing its own platform for ways an attacker could break in. Harjot says the early access helped CodeRabbit secure its own stack. “We found multiple vulnerabilities, advanced hacks that we could not even imagine could happen,” Harjot says.
blocks.zh: 团队使用该模型进行内部穿透测试,调查攻击者可能闯入的平台Harjot说早期访问帮助CodeRabbit保护了自己的堆栈.“我们发现多种弱点,哈乔特说,
blocks.en: The team used the model for internal penetration testing, probing its own platform for ways an attacker could break in. Harjot says the early access helped CodeRabbit secure its own stack. “We found multiple vulnerabilities, advanced hacks that we could not even imagine could happen,” Harjot says.

blocks.text: It has since taken those capabilities to market, helping secure its customers’ code with its latest product, CodeRabbit Secure. Over the past two weeks, the company ran a promotional offer where it covered $1M in free deep scans for their users and found over 43,000 security vulnerabilities across 13,000 deep scans, all powered by Codex models. Thousands of these vulnerabilities have already been fixed by its customers, helping improve their code security.
blocks.zh: 之后,它利用这些能力进行市场营销,帮助用其最新产品来保障客户的代码,代码Rabbit安全。在过去两周里,公司开出了一个促销报价,其中为用户提供免费的深度扫描费用1M美元,并发现在13 000个深度扫描中存在超过43 000个安全漏洞,所有由 Codex 模型提供动力。数以千计的这些脆弱性已经由客户解决,帮助改善他们的代码安全。
blocks.en: It has since taken those capabilities to market, helping secure its customers’ code with its latest product, CodeRabbit Secure. Over the past two weeks, the company ran a promotional offer where it covered $1M in free deep scans for their users and found over 43,000 security vulnerabilities across 13,000 deep scans, all powered by Codex models. Thousands of these vulnerabilities have already been fixed by its customers, helping improve their code security.

blocks.text: Keeping developers in control of agent-generated code
blocks.zh: 使开发者控制代理生成的代码
blocks.en: Keeping developers in control of agent-generated code

blocks.text: As background agents begin responding to alerts and incidents without a person initiating every task, Harjot expects teams to need more help deciding which changes to take to completion.
blocks.zh: 当背景智能体开始对警报和事件作出反应时,没有一个人发起每一项任务,Harjot希望各小组需要更多的帮助来决定完成哪些变化。
blocks.en: As background agents begin responding to alerts and incidents without a person initiating every task, Harjot expects teams to need more help deciding which changes to take to completion.

blocks.text: Looking ahead, CodeRabbit is expanding toward agentic software development, helping teams validate, prioritize, explain, secure, and verify agent-generated code changes at scale.
blocks.zh: 展望未来,CodeRabbit正在向代理软件的开发发展,帮助团队验证,优先排序,解释一下,安全,并按规模验证代理生成的代码更改。
blocks.en: Looking ahead, CodeRabbit is expanding toward agentic software development, helping teams validate, prioritize, explain, secure, and verify agent-generated code changes at scale.

blocks.text: The opportunity is to help developers stay in control as agents do more of the building, with validation, explanations, and maintenance that keep pace with the code being produced.
blocks.zh: 机会是帮助开发者保持控制 随着代理 做更多的建筑,与验证,解释,与正在制作的代码保持同步的维护。
blocks.en: The opportunity is to help developers stay in control as agents do more of the building, with validation, explanations, and maintenance that keep pace with the code being produced.
